title: Tenant SLO Enforcer with KV-budgeted Fairness and Memory-aware Yielding
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description:
Goal: Implement an SLO Enforcer that enforces tenant latency & throughput SLOs while maximizing GPU utilization by combining a KV-cache budget accounting layer with a memory-aware fairness controller. The enforcer must:
- Continuously monitor per-tenant moving-window latency (p50/p95/p99) and effective token throughput.
- Maintain a per-tenant KV budget that tracks resident KV size and estimated working-set pressure on the GPU.
- Allocate GPU memory and batching slots using a 'budgeted fairness' algorithm: tenants receive slot/credit allocations proportional to SLO urgency and inverse-proportional to KV residency fraction (to avoid certifying eviction storms).
- Perform graceful yield actions when a tenant exceeds budget or risks causing SLO violations: reduce batch admission rate, shift to a smaller model variant, or route to dedicated capacity depending on policy.

Design constraints and non-goals:
- Non-goal: Replace global preemptor logic; this enforcer should integrate with the existing preemption layer and provide scoring and soft-yield signals.
- Must avoid frequent KV thrashing: eviction penalties are charged against a tenant's budget to discourage oscillation.
- Target environments: hosted and Dedicated pools (private will be considered after initial rollout).

Success metrics (first 8 weeks):
- Reduce p99 latency SLO misses for SLO-tiered customers by >= 40% under 70-95% GPU utilization workloads.
- Keep KV-eviction churn <= 10% of baseline while increasing average GPU token throughput by >= 12%.
- Avoid regressing best-effort tenant throughput by more than 8%.

Rollout plan:
1) Canary: implement enforcer in scoring mode (no enforcement) on one host pool for 2 weeks to validate signals and telemetry.
2) Soft-enforce: introduce admission caps and KV budget throttles (non-migratory) for a subset of tenants.
3) Full-enforce: enable model-variant fallback and scale-to-dedicated actions for enterprise tenants with explicit opt-in.

Telemetry and dashboards:
- Per-tenant: KV_residency_bytes, KV_eviction_rate, budget_balance, slot_credits, preemption_score, observed_p95_latency.
- Pool-level: overall GPU mem headroom, eviction churn, enforced_yield_count, model_variant_fallbacks.

Integrations and artifacts:
- Design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/198273/kv+budgeted+fairness
- Simulation harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/tree/main/sim/kv-budget-sim
- Draft PR for scoring hooks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

Security and compliance notes:
- KV budgeting touches per-tenant memory accounting; KMS/secrets unaffected but audit logging must capture enforcement decisions for regulated customers. Security review required before soft-enforce rollout.
comments: 2025-02-12 by Marcus Liu: Initial spike analysis shows eviction storms correlate with p99 degradations when GPU util > 80%. Proposed per-tenant budget heuristic: budget = min(max_budget, baseline_residency + weight*(active_requests)). Added simulator to reproduce churn.

2025-02-20 by Sofia Alvarez: Simulation: under mixed workload, budgeted fairness reduced simulated eviction churn from 27% -> 9% and improved p95 by ~22% at 85% util. Need to validate estimator accuracy for resident KV size under streaming workloads.

2025-02-25 by Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed rollout stages. Ask: include a per-tenant override for high-priority business flows and expose a mitigation reason in audit logs. Added label 'slo-exempt' for exempt tenants.

2025-02-28 by Marcus Liu: RFC posted in Confluence and PR#4821 opened to add scoring extension points and telemetry hooks. Requesting design review from infra-rt and telemetry teams. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

2025-03-03 by Tobias Kline (SRE): Load test in staging with 12 tenants. Observed budget thrash with request bursts; implemented a conservative cooldown (5s) for budget replenishment which eliminated oscillation in 3/3 runs.
2025-03-04 by Security Bot: Flagged enforcement actions must be recorded to audit-log stream with tenant id, reason, and pre/post budget. Security review scheduled for 2025-03-10.

2025-03-04 by Marcus Liu: Next steps: finish PR for scoring integration, add dashboard panels (INV-alloc, budget_balance trend), run 48h canary in us-west-2 with scoring-only mode starting 2025-03-06. Assigned to Marcus and Sofia for the canary phase.
